cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with a prominent reinforcing strong anionic Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (3) -> strong (buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine 6 does not offset a reinforcing route).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Silicones (10, 13), guar (15) and betaine buffer; TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (16) is after Parfum and not counted.
cleansingStrength.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 met: early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol (10), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (15), pearlizing route Glycol Distearate (7) and a deliberate humectant entry Panthenol (24); second silicone Dimethicone (13). Strong cleansing does not lower conditioning (C2).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Guar and Panthenol sit late (after Parfum); Dimethiconol is the last prominent entry; the cleansing chassis is strong.
conditioningLevel.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

weightPotential.rationale: Two silicones plus cationic guar form a plausible silicone/guar deposition system; strong reset and absence of any payload lipid keep it bounded.
weightPotential.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

depositionLoad.rationale: Dimethiconol (10) + Dimethicone (13) + Guar HPTC (15): a coacervate-type silicone deposition system.

persistence.rationale: Silicones are persistent and guar aids their deposition; no lipid/film former reinforces.

weightRecord.counterevidence: Not high: no W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid), no second cationic or film former, and a strong reset faces the system. Not low: two silicones plus a deposition polymer are two converging families (W2). W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone), so it is not cited.
weightRecord.whyThisBand: At least one persistent depositing system (silicone + guar) is plausible enough that calling it lightweight would understate residue.
weightRecord.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid), no second cationic or film former, and a strong reset faces the system. Not low: two silicones plus a deposition polymer are two converging families (W2). W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone), so it is not cited.
weightRecord.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone levels unknown; two silicones could plausibly read heavier (neighbor high, heavier value on an equally realistic tie).
weightRecord.claimsEffect: Claims read after freeze; none changes the band (6.5 step 5).
